description: Use this when the user wants printable bingo cards: a bingo card generator or bingo card maker for a holiday party, classroom, baby shower, team meeting, or any game with their own words or phrases, or classic number bingo (1-75) or UK 90-ball tickets. Makes 1-200 different cards (3x3, 4x4 or 5x5, free centre on or off) with each item spread evenly, optionally so that no two cards share a winning line. Returns card 1, balance and uniqueness numbers, and links to a cards PDF (1, 2, 4 or 6 per page, cut lines), a caller sheet PDF and a CSV. Does not add pictures, and does not draw items or check claims (use show_bingo_caller). Not for a single personal goals card (use generate_goal_bingo) or for prize or money games.

accent_color.description: Theme colour as hex or a name, e.g. #2B8A3E, red, green, gold, pink, purple, teal, christmas. Default raspberry #C2255C.

card_count.description: How many different cards (or tickets) to make, 1-200, e.g. 30. Default 30.

cards_per_page.description: Cards per printed page: 1, 2, 4 or 6, e.g. 2. Default 2 (6 for 90-ball tickets). Pages get dashed cut lines.

free_label.description: Text in the free centre square, e.g. FREE (default), Santa, or Baby.

free_space.description: Free centre square on 3x3 and 5x5 cards, e.g. true. Default true for 5x5 and false for 3x3; 4x4 cards have no centre.

grid_size.description: Card size for mode words: 3, 4 or 5 (default 5), e.g. 5. Classic numbers_75 is always 5x5; numbers_90 tickets are always 3x9.

items.description: For mode words: the words or phrases to put on the cards, one per entry, e.g. ["Ugly sweater", "Mistletoe", "Hot cocoa"]. Need at least 24 for 5x5 with a free centre, 25 without, 16 for 4x4, 8 or 9 for 3x3. Up to 300, each up to 100 characters.

mode.description: words (default): your own words or phrases. numbers_75: classic US bingo, 5x5 with B 1-15, I 16-30, N 31-45, G 46-60, O 61-75. numbers_90: UK-style 3x9 tickets with 15 numbers from 1-90, printed in strips of 6. Example: words.

paper.description: Paper size for the PDFs, e.g. letter (default) or a4.

seed.description: Card set number from an earlier result, e.g. 4242. The same items, options and seed always rebuild the same cards. Leave out for a new random set.

title.description: Heading printed on every card, e.g. Holiday Party Bingo. Default Bingo.

unique_lines.description: true = no two cards share an identical winning line (row, column or diagonal), so two players never complete the very same line. Needs enough items; the tool explains if the request is not possible. Default false (cards are always all different).

name: generate_bingo_cards
title: Generate bingo cards
